The person is a health administrative law enforcement officer (卫生行政执法人员) who, in cases of illegal medical practice (非法行医), instead of referring to criminal prosecution, he used administrative penalties (fine) and allowed them to continue, for economic benefit. This is abuse of power, dereliction of duty, possibly "徇私舞弊" which is a crime: "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power for personal gain). In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime called "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of public power, i.e., dereliction of duty). The examples: earlier we saw "受贿;滥用职权" for a case where a public official accepted bribes and abused power. Here, the conduct is not receiving bribes (though maybe economic benefit). He used his position to avoid criminal prosecution, which is "徇私舞弊罪". Also possibly "滥用职权罪" (abuse of power). The description: "徇私舞弊，对依法应当移交司法机关追究刑事责任的...不移交，放纵其继续实施非法行医犯罪活动". This matches the crime of "徇私舞弊罪". In Chinese law, article 397 of Criminal Law: "国家机关工作人员徇私舞弊，致使应当追究刑事责任的犯罪分子不受追究的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑。" So the charge is "徇私舞弊".
